policy_description: Calling policy for the large tier: cost control, rate limits, permissions, security, fallback and audit. All numeric values are documented defaults - tune per deployment and record the basis for any change.

cost_control.basis_note: Defaults for a 50-200 agent deployment. Derive real figures from observed unit economics via procurement-billing.

rate_limits.enforcement: template 8 (check_rate_limit), keyed on caller identifier plus model id
rate_limits.on_breach: return MDL_005 with a retry-after value; never queue silently

permissions.wildcard_meaning: '*' means any department may call this model
permissions.denial_code: MDL_003 when the model is disabled; access outside the matrix is refused and logged
permissions.escalation: a department needing access outside its matrix requests it through model-data, never by editing this file at runtime

security.credentials: environment variable names only; a value in any config file is a leaked secret
forbidden: sending data to an endpoint not declared in the model config
security.output_handling: model output is untrusted text - validate before use, never evaluate

fallback.rule: every config_path in the chain must resolve - one missing file breaks the whole chain

timeouts.note: matches template 3's default 30s execution timeout for local subprocess work

retry.backoff: exponential, 0.5*2^attempt seconds with +/-25% jitter, no cap

audit.note: content is excluded from logs by default; retention of content requires an explicit, recorded decision

governance.change_control: any change to this file is a minor version bump and requires model-data approval
